items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer lists Ziggie Elman among people who 'used to come in all the time and sit in' with the band, but the interviewee (Cozy Cole) does not respond to confirm a personal relationship or specific interaction.

ctx.x: Did he used to bring a lot of people off the stands?

Well no, mostly everybody knew that about Stuff and used to come up there and sit in you know and play. Artie Dollinger was a saxophone player, later on he was on staff. He used to come in and sit and play with us all the time. Bernie Privin, come in and sit in with us. Jack Teagarden, Jimmy Dorsey, Tommy, Artie Shaw, Benny, Chris Griffin, Ziggie Elman, Allen Reuss, guitar. What's the trombone player's name, oh, he used to be with Benny. He used to come in all the time and sit in.
